name: Source: Pakistan
notes: Figures read from SBP, PBS, Finance Ministry and FBR releases, market closes, and news reports of them. Every row carries its own source link.
takeaway: Inflation of 10.3% is well above the State Bank's 5–7% target, so the policy rate is back up at 12.00%. Buffers are thicker, with SBP reserves at $21.52bn, but the current account has slipped back into deficit: −$874m in July–September.

curve.note: Cut-off yields from the 28 Oct T-bill auction, after the October rate hike, and the 7 Oct PIB auction, compared with the 16 Sep T-bill and 18 Sep PIB auctions.
